<entry name="Orks/ProphetOfTheWaaaghFlavor" value="“I'm da hand of Gork and Mork, dey sent me to rouse up da boyz to crush and kill 'cos da boyz forgot what dere 'ere for… I'm da profit of da Waaagh an' whole worlds burn in my boot prints. I'm Warlord Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka an' I speak wiv da word of da gods.”
— Ghazghkull Mag Uruk Thraka, Ork Warlord"/>
<entry name="Tyranids/AlphaWarriorFlavor" value="“To think that Tyranids are mindless beasts is a grave mistake. When you fight Tyranids you face not only those before you on the battlefield, but the untold thousands which seek to surround you, which attack your supporting units and destroy your supply lines in perfect synchronicity.”
— Marneus Calgar, Chapter Master of the Ultramarines"/>
<entry name="Tyranids/ScourgeOfTheBroodFlavor" value="“As I looked into its dead black eyes, I saw the terrible sentience it had in place of a soul. Behind that was the steel will of its leader. Further still I could feel its primogenitor coldly assessing me from the void. And looking back from the deepest recesses of the alien's mind I perceived what I can only describe as an immortal hunger.”
— Chief Librarian Varro Tigurius of the Ultramarines"/>
<entry name="Tyranids/BroodProgenitorFlavor" value="“This horror, this abomination, has thought and purpose that functions on an unimaginable, galactic scale and all we can do is try to stop the swarms of bioengineered monsters it unleashes upon us by instinct. We have given the horror a name to salve our fears; we call it the Tyranid race, but if it is aware of us at all it must know us only as Prey.”
— Inquisitor Czevak"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/StirringRhetoricFlavor" value="“There is no light but the light of the Emperor! There is no faith but faith in the Emperor! There is no truth but the truth of the Emperor!”
— First Exclamation of the Dialogus Order of the Resounding Vow"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/SacralVigorFlavor" value="“What of these wounds upon us, sisters? Is our flesh that precious to us, our beauty that sacred? Tear at these cuts, open them, they are but motes in fanciful air. Never forget that our reality is faith, and pain, like life, is evanescent…”
— Canoness Vandire, In Memoriam De Virtute"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/ThePassionDescription" value="Increases the melee accuracy and armor of the Canoness and adjacent allied units.
"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/LightOfTheEmperorDescription" value="Increases the accuracy, sight and heals for a small amount.
"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/MartyredArsenalFlavor" value="“And the faithful shall be relentless in their inquisition. Nothing shall stand in the way of their will; neither the laws of men nor xenos; not qualms nor friends; not steel nor plascrete nor adamantium.”
— Canoness Vandire, In Memoriam De Virtute"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/BenedictionOfTheHolyMachineDescription" value="Increases the Range of all weapons by 1 tile for 1 turn.
"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/FaithDrivenAfterburnDescription" value="Increases the movement speed by 2 for 1 turn.
"/>
<entry name="SistersOfBattle/LanceOfTheEmperorDescription" value="Increases the movementspeed by 2, but prevents the use of ranged weapons.
"/> <entry name="SistersOfBattle/LanceOfTheEmperorFlavor" value="“One should not question the nobility of Questor Imperialis. But for faith, none can match the Knight-Lancer, which goes into battle armed only with a spear and its own prodigious speed, praying that it makes it to the enemy lines. It is a fine match for our forces.”
— Canoness Vandire, In Nomine Strategi"/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraBasicDescription" value="Increases all unit and building production by 5%.
Increases Ore, Food, Energy, and Research output by 5%, and Influence by 10%.
Only one Edict can be active at a time."/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraDefenceDescription" value="Increases the armour of all Units on city tiles by 2
Increases Unit production of Imperial Baracks by 25%.
Increases Influence production by 15%.
Only one Edict can be active at a time."/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraProdDescription" value="Increases Production speed of Imperial Barracks, Manufactorum and Veteran Barracks by 25%.
Increases building production speed by 10%
Only one Edict can be active at a time. "/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraProd2Description" value="Increases Production speed of Heavy Armour Complex and Heavy Support Foundry by 20%. except the Headquarters.
Only one Edict can be active at a time."/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraResDescription" value="Edict that increases the Ore, Energy, Food and Influence output of all buildings in the city by 25%
Only one Edict can be active at a time."/>
<entry name="AstraMilitarum/AstraUtilityDescription" value="Edict that increases Research output by 33%.
Increases Ore, Energy, Food and Influence production by 10%
Only one Edict can be active at a time."/>

<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/BulwarkImperativeDescription" value="Increases the armour, but decreases the movement of Doctrina Imperatives units.
Cost scales with the amount of affected units (up to 10)."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/ProtectorImperativeDescription" value="Increases the ranged accuracy, but decreases the armour of Doctrina Imperatives units.
Cost scales with the amount of affected units (up to 10)."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/ConquerorImperativeDescription" value="Increases the melee accuracy, but decreases the sight range of Doctrina Imperatives units.
Cost scales with the amount of affected units (up to 10)."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/AggressorImperativeDescription" value="Increases the movement, but decreases the ranged accuracy of Doctrina Imperatives units.
Cost scales with the amount of affected units (up to 10)."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/LitanyOfTheElectromancerDescription" value="Damage ability with global range targeting 1 unit.
Attack and cost scale with the amount of Canticles of the Omnissiah units (up to 10). Base Attack 1 Attack + 1 Attack per unit."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/Shroudpsalm1Description" value="Reduces the accuracy of an enemy unit for 2 turns.
The effectiveness is increased by the number of Canticles of the Omnissiah units under your control (up to 10 units). Base debuff: 25% + 7.5% per unit."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/BenedictionOfOmniscience1Description" value="Increases the damage reduction of a unit.
The effectiveness is increased by the number of Canticles of the Omnissiah units under your control (up to 10 units). Base effect: 21% + 3% per unit."/>
<entry name="AdeptusMechanicus/IncantationOfTheIronSoul1Description" value="Increases the Morale of all Units of a target unit and all tiles around it.
The effectiveness is increased by the number of Canticles of the Omnissiah units under your control (up to 10 units). Base effect: 2 Morale + 0.3 per unit."/>
<entry name="AssaultDoctrineDescription" value="Basic Doctrine: Grants 10% reduced damage from ranged attacks and +1 Melee Accuracy.
Affects Assault Space Marines, Scout Bikers, Invader ATV, Primaris Inceptors, Primaris Aggressors, Land Speeder, Stormspeeders, Razorbacks, Apothecaries, Dreadnoughts, Redemptor Dreadnoughts, Assault Terminators, Landraiders, Stromraven and Stormtalon Units.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/> <entry name="AssaultDoctrineFlavor" value="“Where there is uncertainty, I shall bring light
Where there is doubt, I shall sow faith.
Where there is shame, I shall point atonement.
Where there is rage, I shall show its course.
My word in the soul shall be as my bolter in the field.”
— Litany of Devotion, traditional"/>
<entry name="TacticalDoctrineDescription" value="Basic Doctrine: Grants 10% more attacks and 10% Ranged damage reduction bypass.
Affects Tactical Space Marines, Primaris Intercessors, Scouts, Primaris Hellblasters, Terminators, Razorbacks, Hunters, Land Speeder, Land Raider, Predators, Repulsor Executioner and Stromraven and Stormtalon Units.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/> <entry name="TacticalDoctrineFlavor" value="“They shall be pure of heart and strong of body, untainted by doubt and unsullied by self-aggrandisement. They will be bright stars on the firmament of battle, Angels of Death whose shining wings bring swift annihilation to the enemies of Man. So it shall be for a thousand times for a thousand years, unto the very end of eternity and the extinction of mortal flesh.”
— Codex Astartes, by Roboute Guilliman, Primarch of the Ultramarines, Lord Commander and Imperial Regent"/>
<entry name="DevastatorDoctrineDescription" value="Basic Doctrine: Grants +15% Ranged Accuracy.
Affects Devastator Space Marines, Devastator Centurions, Whirlwinds, Vindicators, Thunderfire Cannons, Primaris Aggressors, Land Raiders, Dreadnoughts, Stormspeeders, Stromraven and Stormtalon Units.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/> <entry name="DevastatorDoctrineFlavor" value="“Victory often rests on the correct weaponry being in the right place and at the right time. Even the most destructive weapons of war are worthless if absent from the battle.”
— Artor Amhrad, Chapter Master of the Astral Knights"/>
<entry name="BolterDrillDescription" value="Advanced Doctrine: Grants 1 Movementspeed to Infantry Units, Scoutbikers and ATV'S.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/>
<entry name="TheFleshIsWeakDescription" value="Advanced Doctrine: Increases damage reduction of all units by 17%.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/> <entry name="TheFleshIsWeakFlavor" value="“We have been wounded sorely. Yet still we stand, with fire in our eyes and valour in our hearts. Let them think us beaten. We shall teach them otherwise.”
— Pedro Kantor, Chapter Master of the Crimson Fists"/>
<entry name="MachineEmpathyDescription" value="Advanced Doctrine: Restores 3 hitpoints per turn of vehicle and fortification units. Other Units restore 1 hitpoint per turn.
The Influence cost of this ability scales with the number of affected units, up to a maximum of 20 units."/> <entry name="MachineEmpathyFlavor" value="“Consider the Predator. Let your soul be armoured with Faith, driven on the tracks of obedience which overcomes all obstacles, and armed with the three great guns of Zeal, Duty and Purity.”
— Traditional Imperial prayer, source unknown"/>
